description: Collect public Pinterest Pins, profiles, boards, board sections, idea topics, search results, and comments. No login or cookies required.

boardUrls.description: Public board links, `username/board-name` paths, or a section link such as `https://www.pinterest.com/krity_s/home-decor/mens/`.
boardUrls.title: Board or section URLs

commerceOnly.description: Keep only Pins that carry Pinterest product or shopping metadata.
commerceOnly.title: Shoppable Pins only

enrichPinDetails.description: For `userPins` and `boardPins`, visit each numeric Pin page for detail-only fields. Slower but more complete.
enrichPinDetails.title: Enrich collection Pins

excludeAds.description: Drop Pins that Pinterest explicitly marks as promoted or sponsored.
excludeAds.title: Exclude promoted Pins

ideaSlugs.description: Idea topic path pairs such as `beauty/935541271955`. Used when `mode=ideas`.
ideaSlugs.title: Idea topic paths

ideaUrls.description: Public Pinterest idea-topic links, for example `https://www.pinterest.com/ideas/beauty/935541271955/`.
ideaUrls.title: Idea topic URLs

imageOnly.description: Drop video Pins and keep image Pins only.
imageOnly.title: Image Pins only

includeComments.description: Add real public comment and activity rows for collected numeric Pins.
includeComments.title: Include Pin comments

includeIdeaPins.description: When mode=`ideas`, also emit the Pins shown on the idea-topic page.
includeIdeaPins.title: Include idea-topic Pins

keywords.description: Words or phrases for search modes, for example `minimalist kitchen`.
keywords.title: Search words

language.description: Pinterest UI language. It affects ranked search results and localized labels.
language.title: Language

maxComments.description: Maximum public comment and activity rows per Pin when comments are enabled or mode=`comments`.
maxComments.title: Maximum comments per Pin

maxItems.description: Maximum rows returned across all supplied inputs.
maxItems.title: Max items

maxPages.description: Maximum result pages to walk per feed (one page is about 25-50 Pins).
maxPages.title: Max pages

minCreatorFollowers.description: Keep Pins whose public creator follower count reaches N. Unknown counts pass through.
minCreatorFollowers.title: Minimum creator followers

minSaves.description: Keep Pins whose published save count is at least N. Pins without a published count pass through as unknown.
minSaves.title: Minimum saves

mode.description: Choose the Pinterest use case. Every mode uses public Pinterest data and needs no login.
enumTitles: Comments and Pin activity by URL
Pins inside a board or board section
mode.title: What to collect

pinUrls.description: Public Pinterest Pin links or numeric IDs. Used by mode=`pinDetail` and `comments`. Opaque e1_ IDs from feeds are list-only and cannot be opened directly.
pinUrls.title: Pin URLs or IDs

proxyConfiguration.description: Optional Apify proxy override. The actor automatically falls back to Apify datacenter proxy and direct traffic, so no proxy setup is required.
proxyConfiguration.title: Optional proxy

requireOutboundLink.description: For Pin results, keep only Pins with a public destination URL supplied by Pinterest.
requireOutboundLink.title: Require destination link

startUrls.description: Mixed public Pinterest links for mode=`auto`. Unambiguous Pin, profile, board, board-section, idea, and search links are routed to the matching collector; unsupported links are skipped.
startUrls.title: Pinterest URLs (auto-detect)

usernames.description: Pinterest usernames, @usernames, or public profile links.
usernames.title: Pinterest usernames

verifiedOnly.description: Keep only rows where Pinterest explicitly reports a verified creator or profile.
verifiedOnly.title: Verified accounts only

title: Pinterest Scraper Pro Input
